title: Spätzle mit Tomatensoße
description: A classic German dish featuring homemade spätzle noodles tossed in a rich tomato sauce. Perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Gradually add in the flaky italian pasta and cook until al dente.
While the pasta is cooking, make the homemade spätzle by mixing the jovial all-purpose flour, large egg, salt, and ground black pepper in a bowl.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a long rope.
Cut the rope into 1/2-inch pieces and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add in the chopped tomato and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add in the cooked spätzle noodles and toss in the tomato sauce until well coated.
